Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡزَلَ عَلٰى عَبۡدِهِ الۡكِتٰبَ وَلَمۡ يَجۡعَل لَّهٗ عِوَجَا؄ؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: All praise belongs to Allah Who revealed the (Glorious) Book to His (Most Beloved and Intimate) servant and left not in it any crookedness.

Verses.VerseAr: قَيِّمًا لِّيُنۡذِرَ بَاۡسًا شَدِيۡدًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنۡهُ وَيُبَشِّرَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ اَنَّ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرًا حَسَنًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (He made it) straight and moderate so that he may warn (the disbelievers) of fierce torment (coming) from Allah and give good news to the believers who do pious deeds that for them is excellent reward (Paradise),

Verses.VerseAr: مَّاكِثِيۡنَ فِيۡهِ اَبَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Wherein they will live forever,

Verses.VerseAr: وَّيُنۡذِرَ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ وَلَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (moreover) create fear in those who say that Allah has taken a son (for Himself).

Verses.VerseAr: مَا لَهُمۡ بِهٖ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ وَّلَا لِاَبَآٮِٕهِمۡ‌ؕ كَبُرَتۡ كَلِمَةً تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ‌ؕ اِنۡ يَّقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِلَّا كَذِبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Neither they have any knowledge of it nor had their fathers. How dreadful is (this) utterance that is coming out of their mouths! They speak nothing but (sheer) falsehood.

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَّـفۡسَكَ عَلٰٓى اٰثَارِهِمۡ اِنۡ لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُوۡا بِهٰذَا الۡحَـدِيۡثِ اَسَفًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O Venerable Beloved!) Will you put your (dear) life at stake with the traumatic grief for them if they do not put faith in this Word (of Allah)?

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا مَا عَلَى الۡاَرۡضِ زِيۡنَةً لَّهَا لِنَبۡلُوَهُمۡ اَيُّهُمۡ اَحۡسَنُ عَمَلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And indeed We have made whatever is on earth a means of its beauty (and adornment) so that We test (the inhabitants of the earth) as to who is better on merit of their deeds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنَّا لَجٰعِلُوۡنَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيۡدًا جُرُزًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, surely, We shall reduce it to a barren land (perishing all) that is on (the surface of the earth).

Verses.VerseAr: اَمۡ حَسِبۡتَ اَنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡـكَهۡفِ وَالرَّقِيۡمِۙ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ اٰيٰتِنَا عَجَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you thought of it (how) wondrous a Sign of the Signs (of Our Might) were the people of the Kahf and the Raqim (i.e. the people of Cave and the Cave Tablet or the Raqim valley)?

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ اَوَى الۡفِتۡيَةُ اِلَى الۡـكَهۡفِ فَقَالُوۡا رَبَّنَاۤ اٰتِنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ رَحۡمَةً وَّهَيِّئۡ لَـنَا مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا رَشَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Call to mind the time) when a few youths took refuge in the cave. They said: ‘O our Lord, bestow upon us mercy from Your Presence and provide (means of) guidance in our affair.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَضَرَبۡنَا عَلٰٓى اٰذَانِهِمۡ فِىۡ الۡـكَهۡفِ سِنِيۡنَ عَدَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So We patted their ears (putting them to slumber) for some countable years in that cave.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِنَعۡلَمَ اَىُّ الۡحِزۡبَيۡنِ اَحۡصٰى لِمَا لَبِثُوۡۤا اَمَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then We raised them up to see which of the two groups would most rightly calculate (the time) that they stayed (in the cave).

Verses.VerseAr: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ نَبَاَهُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ فِتۡيَةٌ اٰمَنُوۡا بِرَبِّهِمۡ وَزِدۡنٰهُمۡ هُدًى‌ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We (now) narrate to you their actual state of affairs. They were indeed (a few) young men who believed in their Lord and We increased for them (the light of) guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّرَبَطۡنَا عَلٰى قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اِذۡ قَامُوۡا فَقَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ لَنۡ نَّدۡعُوَا۫ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اِلٰهًـا‌ لَّـقَدۡ قُلۡنَاۤ اِذًا شَطَطًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We strengthened and stabilized their hearts (through Our communication and divine affinity). When they stood (before their king), they said: ‘Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We shall never worship any (false) god besides Him. (If we do that) then we shall certainly say something profane.’

Verses.VerseAr: هٰٓؤُلَۤاءِ قَوۡمُنَا اتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖۤ اٰلِهَةً‌ؕ لَوۡلَا يَاۡتُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍۢ بَيِّنٍ‌ؕ فَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنِ افۡتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: These are the people of our community who have made many gods apart from Him. Why do they not bring any clear proof (in support of their godhood)? So, who is a greater wrongdoer than he who fabricates a lie against Allah?

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذِ اعۡتَزَلۡـتُمُوۡهُمۡ وَمَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ فَاۡوٗۤا اِلَى الۡـكَهۡفِ يَنۡشُرۡ لَـكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ وَيُهَيِّئۡ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَمۡرِكُمۡ مِّرۡفَقًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (those young men mutually discussed:) ‘When you have withdrawn yourselves from them and those (false gods) which they worship other than Allah, take shelter in (this) cave. Your Lord will open up His mercy for you and will facilitate you in your affair.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَى الشَّمۡسَ اِذَا طَلَعَتۡ تَّزٰوَرُ عَنۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَاِذَا غَرَبَتۡ تَّقۡرِضُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمۡ فِىۡ فَجۡوَةٍ مِّنۡهُ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ‌ؕ مَنۡ يَّهۡدِ اللّٰهُ فَهُوَ الۡمُهۡتَدِ‌ۚ وَمَنۡ يُّضۡلِلۡ فَلَنۡ تَجِدَ لَهٗ وَلِيًّا مُّرۡشِدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you see that the sun, when it rises, moves to the right from their cave and inclines obliquely from them to the left when it sets while they are (lying) in the open chamber of the cave. This (change of the sun’s course) is one of the (great) Signs of Allah’s (Might). He whom Allah guides is the one who is rightly guided, but one whom He holds strayed you will not find for him any wali (friend to help) and murshid (guide to show the path).

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ اَيۡقَاظًا وَّهُمۡ رُقُوۡدٌ‌‌ۖ وَنُـقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ‌‌ۖ وَكَلۡبُهُمۡ بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِالۡوَصِيۡدِ‌ؕ لَوِ اطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارًا وَّلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O listener,) if you (look) at them, you will deem them awake whereas they are asleep. And We keep changing their sides to the right and to the left (after regular intervals), and their dog is sitting on (their) threshold sprawling both its forelegs. Had you glanced peeping at them, you would have run away turning your back on them, and your heart would have been filled with their terror.

Words.MeaningEn: and surely you would have been filled

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ بَعَثۡنٰهُمۡ لِيَتَسَآءَلُوۡا بَيۡنَهُمۡ‌ؕ قَالَ قَآٮِٕلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ قَالُوۡا لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا اَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡمٍ‌ؕ قَالُوۡا رَبُّكُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثۡتُمۡؕ فَابۡعَثُوۡۤا اَحَدَكُمۡ بِوَرِقِكُمۡ هٰذِهٖۤ اِلَى الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ فَلۡيَنۡظُرۡ اَيُّهَاۤ اَزۡكٰى طَعَامًا فَلۡيَاۡتِكُمۡ بِرِزۡقٍ مِّنۡهُ وَلۡيَتَلَطَّفۡ وَلَا يُشۡعِرَنَّ بِكُمۡ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And likewise We raised them up so that they could probe among themselves. (So,) the vocal one among them said: ‘How long have you stayed (here)?’ They said: ‘We have tarried (here) for a day or (even) a part of that.’ (Winding it up, they) said: ‘Your Lord knows best how long you have stayed (here). So send someone of you to the city with this coin of yours. He should then find which food is more lawful and clean and bring you some of that. He should remain slow and polite (in going, buying and coming back), not leaving any clue about you (even) to a single person.

Words.MeaningEn: with this silver coin of yours
and let him bring to you

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّهُمۡ اِنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ يَرۡجُمُوۡكُمۡ اَوۡ يُعِيۡدُوۡكُمۡ فِىۡ مِلَّتِهِمۡ وَلَنۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡۤا اِذًا اَبَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely if they overpower you (after becoming aware of you), they will surely stone you to death or force you (through oppression) to return to their faith. And (if it so happens) then you will not prosper at all.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَذٰلِكَ اَعۡثَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَـعۡلَمُوۡۤا اَنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّاَنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهَا‌ۚ اِذۡ يَتَـنَازَعُوۡنَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ اَمۡرَهُمۡ‌ فَقَالُوۡا ابۡنُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ بُنۡيَانًا‌ ؕ رَّبُّهُمۡ اَعۡلَمُ بِهِمۡ‌ؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ غَلَبُوۡا عَلٰٓى اَمۡرِهِمۡ لَـنَـتَّخِذَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّسۡجِدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And in this way We unveiled their (state) to those (who succeeded them some centuries later) so that they might know that Allah’s promise is true and (also) that there is no doubt about the coming of the Last Hour. (When these people of the cave died) and the people of the town developed a dispute concerning their matter, they said: ‘Raise a building over their (cave as a monument). Their Lord knows best their state of (saintly) affairs.’ Those (believers) who had the upper hand in their matter said: ‘We shall certainly build a mosque (at their door so that the believers may pray therein and acquire special bounty by obtaining spiritual nearness to the people of the cave).’

Verses.VerseAr: سَيَـقُوۡلُوۡنَ ثَلٰثَةٌ رَّابِعُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ‌ۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ خَمۡسَةٌ سَادِسُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ رَجۡمًۢا بِالۡغَيۡبِ‌ۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَبۡعَةٌ وَّثَامِنُهُمۡ كَلۡبُهُمۡ‌ؕ قُل رَّبِّىۡۤ اَعۡلَمُ بِعِدَّتِهِمۡ مَّا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلٌ  فَلَا تُمَارِ فِيۡهِمۡ اِلَّا مِرَآءً ظَاهِرًا وَّلَا تَسۡتَفۡتِ فِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Now) some will say: ‘(The people of the cave) were three and the fourth was their dog,’ and still some will say: ‘(They) were five and the sixth was their dog.’ These are the estimations made without seeing. And others will say: ‘(They) were seven and the eighth was their dog.’ Say: ‘My Lord is the One Who exactly knows their number and none knows their (exact number) except a few.’ So do not discuss about them with anyone except the details that have been revealed. Nor seek any information from any of them (about the people of the Cave).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَا تَقُوۡلَنَّ لِشَاىۡءٍ اِنِّىۡ فَاعِلٌ ذٰلِكَ غَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And never say about anything: ‘I shall do this work tomorrow.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ وَاذۡكُرْ رَّبَّكَ اِذَا نَسِيۡتَ وَقُلۡ عَسٰٓى اَنۡ يَّهۡدِيَنِ رَبِّىۡ لِاَقۡرَبَ مِنۡ هٰذَا رَشَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: But that: ‘If Allah so wills. (i.e. saying: Insha Allah).’ And remember your Lord when you forget and say: ‘I believe my Lord will show me the path of guidance which is (even) nearer than this one.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَبِثُوۡا فِىۡ كَهۡفِهِمۡ ثَلٰثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِيۡنَ وَازۡدَادُوۡا تِسۡعًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the people of the Cave [Kahf]) stayed in their cave for three hundred years and they added another (nine) years (to that).

Verses.VerseAr: قُلِ اللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثُوۡا‌ۚ لَهٗ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ‌ؕ اَبۡصِرۡ بِهٖ وَاَسۡمِعۡ‌ؕ مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا يُشۡرِكُ فِىۡ حُكۡمِهٖۤ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Allah is the One Who knows best for how long they remained (there).’ He alone knows (all) the secrets of the heavens and the earth. How well He sees and how well He hears! They have no protector besides Him, nor does He share His Sovereignty with anyone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاتۡلُ مَاۤ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ مِنۡ كِتَابِ رَبِّكَ‌ؕ لَا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمٰتِهٖ‌ ‌ۚ وَلَنۡ تَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And recite that (Revelation) which has been revealed to you from the Book of your Lord. There is none who can change His Word, nor will you find any place of refuge except with Him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاصۡبِرۡ نَفۡسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ بِالۡغَدٰوةِ وَالۡعَشِىِّ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَهٗ‌ وَلَا تَعۡدُ عَيۡنَاكَ عَنۡهُمۡ‌ۚ تُرِيۡدُ زِيۡنَةَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا‌ۚ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مَنۡ اَغۡفَلۡنَا قَلۡبَهٗ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِنَا وَاتَّبَعَ هٰوٮهُ وَكَانَ اَمۡرُهٗ فُرُطًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (O My servant!) Stay tenaciously in the companionship of those who remember their Lord morning and evening, ardently seeking His pleasure, (keen on the glimpse of His sight and eagerly aspiring to glance at His radiant Countenance). Your (affectionate and caring) looks must not but focus them. Do you seek the charisma of the worldly life (shifting your attention away from these self-denying devotees)? And (also) do not follow him whose heart We have made neglectful of Our remembrance and who follows but the urge of his (ill-commanding self) and his case has exceeded all bounds.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقُلِ الۡحَـقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ‌ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيُؤۡمِنۡ وَّمَنۡ شَآءَ فَلۡيَكۡفُرۡ ‌ۙاِنَّاۤ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ نَارًاۙ اَحَاطَ بِهِمۡ سُرَادِقُهَا‌ؕ وَاِنۡ يَّسۡتَغِيۡثُوۡا يُغَاثُوۡا بِمَآءٍ كَالۡمُهۡلِ يَشۡوِىۡ الۡوُجُوۡهَ‌ؕ بِئۡسَ الشَّرَابُ وَسَآءَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And say: ‘(This) Truth is from your Lord. So whoever desires may believe and whoever desires may deny.’ Indeed We have prepared for the wrongdoers the Fire (of Hell) whose walls will surround them. And if (due to thirst and distress) they cry, they will be helped with water like molten copper which will scald their faces. How dreadful a drink and how terrible a resting place!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ اِنَّا لَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ مَنۡ اَحۡسَنَ عَمَلاً‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed those who believe and do pious deeds, We certainly do not waste his reward who does pious deeds.

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهِمُ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ يُحَلَّوۡنَ فِيۡهَا مِنۡ اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّيَلۡبَسُوۡنَ ثِيَابًا خُضۡرًا مِّنۡ سُنۡدُسٍ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٍ مُّتَّكِــِٕيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَى الۡاَرَآٮِٕكِ‌ؕ نِعۡمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتۡ مُرۡتَفَقًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: For them there are (everlasting) Gardens with streams flowing under their (palaces). They will be adorned with bracelets of gold in these Gardens, and they will wear green attires of fine brocade and heavy silk. And there they will recline upon raised and richly adorned thrones. What an excellent reward and how beautiful a resting place!

Verses.VerseAr: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلاً رَّجُلَيۡنِ جَعَلۡنَا لِاَحَدِهِمَا جَنَّتَيۡنِ مِنۡ اَعۡنَابٍ وَّحَفَفۡنٰهُمَا بِنَخۡلٍ وَّجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمَا زَرۡعًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And relate to them the example of two men, one of whom We provided with two gardens of grapevines, and We hedged both from all sides with date-palms and We grew between them (rich green) cultivated fields.

Verses.VerseAr: كِلۡتَا الۡجَـنَّتَيۡنِ اٰتَتۡ اُكُلَهَا وَلَمۡ تَظۡلِمۡ مِّنۡهُ شَيْئًا ۙ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا خِلٰلَهُمَا نَهَرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Both these gardens yielded (abundant) fruits and their (produce) did not fall short of the mark. And We (also) made one stream flow in the middle of (each of) the two.

Words.MeaningEn: And We caused to gush forth

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَانَ لَهٗ ثَمَرٌ‌ۚ فَقَالَ لِصَاحِبِهٖ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗۤ اَنَا اَكۡثَرُ مِنۡكَ مَالاً وَّاَعَزُّ نَفَرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And this man had (also besides this) abundant fruits (i.e. resources). While exchanging views with his companion, he said to him: ‘I am far more affluent than you and (also) more honourable as regards family and tribal strength.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهٗ وَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ لِّنَفۡسِهٖ‌ۚ قَالَ مَاۤ اَظُنُّ اَنۡ تَبِيۡدَ هٰذِهٖۤ اَبَدًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (taking him along) he entered his garden. Doing wrong to his soul (by way of arrogance), he said: ‘I do not (even) imagine that this garden will perish.

Verses.VerseAr: وَّمَاۤ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآٮِٕمَةً ۙ وَّلَٮِٕنۡ رُّدِدتُّ اِلٰى رَبِّىۡ لَاَجِدَنَّ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهَا مُنۡقَلَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nor do I entertain the idea that the Last Hour will take place. And if (supposedly) I am returned to my Lord, even then I shall certainly get a place to return better than these gardens.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَهٗ صَاحِبُهٗ وَهُوَ يُحَاوِرُهٗۤ اَكَفَرۡتَ بِالَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكَ مِنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِنۡ نُّـطۡفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوّٰٮكَ رَجُلاًؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: His companion, while exchanging views with him, said to him: ‘Have you denied (the Lord) Who has created you (first) from clay and then from a drop of vital fluid and then accomplished you (physically) into a full-grown man?

Verses.VerseAr: لّٰـكِنَّا هُوَ اللّٰهُ رَبِّىۡ وَلَاۤ اُشۡرِكُ بِرَبِّىۡۤ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: But (this is what) I say: Allah alone is my Lord and I do not associate any partner with my Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَوۡلَاۤ اِذۡ دَخَلۡتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلۡتَ مَا شَآءَ اللّٰهُۙ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ‌ۚ اِنۡ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنۡكَ مَالاً وَّوَلَدًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And why did you not say when you entered your garden: Ma Sha Allah, la quwwata illa bi-llah – (It happens exactly as Allah wills. No one owns any power but with the help of Allah)? If (today) you find me inferior to you in wealth and riches (then what!)

Verses.VerseAr: فَعَسٰى رَبِّىۡۤ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَنِ خَيۡرًا مِّنۡ جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡهَا حُسۡبَانًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيۡدًا زَلَـقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is not far from possible that my Lord may give me a garden better than yours and send from heaven some torment upon this (garden) turning it into a barren slippery piece of land.

Verses.VerseAr: اَوۡ يُصۡبِحَ مَآؤُهَا غَوۡرًا فَلَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ لَهٗ طَلَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Or its water may sink so deep into the earth that it gets beyond your means to fetch.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُحِيۡطَ بِثَمَرِهٖ فَاَصۡبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيۡهِ عَلَىٰ مَاۤ اَنۡفَقَ فِيۡهَا وَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلٰى عُرُوۡشِهَا وَيَقُوۡلُ يٰلَيۡتَنِىۡ لَمۡ اُشۡرِكۡ بِرَبِّىۡۤ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (because of his arrogance) all his fruits were besieged (with destruction) and in the morning he was but wringing his hands with grief bewailing all that wealth which he had invested (in raising this garden). And the garden had fallen down on its trellises and he (the embodiment of despair and despondence) said: ‘Would that I had not attributed peers to Allah (and had not employed self-conceit)!’

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ لَّهٗ فِئَةٌ يَّـنۡصُرُوۡنَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنۡتَصِرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And there was (also) no party for him to come to his help against Allah, nor was he himself able to avenge (this destruction).

Verses.VerseAr: هُنَالِكَ الۡوَلَايَةُ لِلّٰهِ الۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ عُقۡبًا
Verses.VerseEn: (Here it becomes evident) that all authority belongs to Allah alone (Who) is the Truth. He is the Best to reward and the Best to end.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا كَمَآءٍ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ فَاخۡتَلَطَ بِهٖ نَبَاتُ الۡاَرۡضِ فَاَصۡبَحَ هَشِيۡمًا تَذۡرُوۡهُ الرِّيٰحُ‌ؕ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ مُّقۡتَدِرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And explain to them the example of the worldly life (as well): it is like water that We pour from the sky. With this the vegetation of the earth grows thick, but then it becomes dry stubble which the winds blow about and Allah has Perfect Control over everything.

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡمَالُ وَالۡبَـنُوۡنَ زِيۡنَةُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا‌ۚ وَالۡبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّخَيۡرٌ اَمَلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Wealth and children are (mere) adornment of the worldly life, but the things that (actually) endure (are) the good deeds (which) are best in the Sight of your Lord as for reward and (also) most valuable as regards hope.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ نُسَيِّرُ الۡجِبَالَ وتَرَى الۡاَرۡضَ بَارِزَةً وَّحَشَرۡنٰهُمۡ فَلَمۡ نُغَادِرۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اَحَدًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That will be the Day (of Resurrection) when We shall move the mountains (in the atmosphere, broken to dust particles,) and you will see the earth as a clear plain (void of plantation, stones, animals and vegetation). And We shall gather together the whole of mankind and shall not leave out anyone of them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَعُرِضُوۡا عَلٰى رَبِّكَ صَفًّاؕ لَّقَدۡ جِئۡتُمُوۡنَا كَمَا خَلَقۡنٰكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ  بَلۡ زَعَمۡتُمۡ اَلَّنۡ نَّجۡعَلَ لَـكُمۡ مَّوۡعِدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (all) mankind will be presented to your Lord standing in rows. (It will be said to them:) ‘Indeed you have come to Us (Today the way) We created you for the first time. In fact you thought that We would never appoint for you the Hour of Promise.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَوُضِعَ الۡكِتٰبُ فَتَرَى الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ مُشۡفِقِيۡنَ مِمَّا فِيۡهِ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ يٰوَيۡلَـتَـنَا مَالِ هٰذَا الۡـكِتٰبِ لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيۡرَةً وَّلَا كَبِيۡرَةً اِلَّاۤ اَحۡصٰٮهَا‌ۚ وَوَجَدُوۡا مَا عَمِلُوۡا حَاضِرًا‌ؕ وَلَا يَظۡلِمُ رَبُّكَ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the record of deeds will be placed (before everyone). So, you will see the evildoers terrified at the (sins, wrongs and offences) registered (in the record). And they will say: ‘Oh, woe to us! What is the matter with this record that it has left out neither any insignificant (wrong) nor any big (blunder). It has rather taken into account (each and every act).’ And they will find (before them) whatever they used to do, and your Lord will not do injustice to anyone.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةِ اسۡجُدُوۡا لِاَدَمَ فَسَجَدُوۡۤا اِلَّاۤ اِبۡلِيۡسَؕ كَانَ مِنَ الۡجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَنۡ اَمۡرِ رَبِّهٖؕ اَفَتَـتَّخِذُوۡنَهٗ وَذُرِّيَّتَهٗۤ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِىۡ وَهُمۡ لَـكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ ؕ بِئۡسَ لِلظّٰلِمِيۡنَ بَدَلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (recall the time) when We said to the angels: ‘Prostrate yourselves before Adam (in veneration).’ So they all prostrated themselves except Iblis. He (Iblis) was of the jinn and he walked out of the obedience to his Lord. Are you taking him and his offspring for friends leaving Me whereas in truth they are your enemies? How evil a substitute the evildoers (have opted in My place)!

Verses.VerseAr: مَّاۤ اَشۡهَدتُّهُمۡ خَلۡقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا خَلۡقَ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمَا كُنۡتُ مُتَّخِذَ الۡمُضِلِّيۡنَ عَضُدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: I called them neither (for assistance or witness) on the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor (at the time of) their own creation. Nor was it My Glory to take the inciters of misguidance as (My) supporters.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَوۡمَ يَقُوۡلُ نَادُوۡا شُرَكَآءِىَ الَّذِيۡنَ زَعَمۡتُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَهُمۡ وَجَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّوۡبِقًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (remember) the Day (when) Allah will say: ‘Call those that you deemed to be My peers.’ So they will call them but they will not give them any answer, and We shall place between them (a valley of Hell), the site of destruction.

Verses.VerseAr: وَرَاَ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ النَّارَ فَظَنُّوۡۤا اَنَّهُمۡ مُّوَاقِعُوۡهَا وَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا عَنۡهَا مَصۡرِفًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the evildoers will see the Fire of Hell and realize that certainly they are about to fall into it. And they will not be able to find any means to escape from it.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ صَرَّفۡنَا فِىۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ لِلنَّاسِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍ‌ؕ وَكَانَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَكۡثَرَ شَىۡءٍ جَدَلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We have indeed put forth in the Qur’an repeatedly for mankind every kind of example (alternating the styles) but man is far ahead in contention than anything else.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ اَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡۤا اِذۡ جَآءَهُمُ الۡهُدٰى وَيَسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ سُنَّةُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ قُبُلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And nothing prevented the people from embracing faith and imploring forgiveness from their Lord, while guidance had reached them, except (waiting for) the pattern of the ancients’ (destruction) occurring to them or that the torment should come in front of them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ اِلَّا مُبَشِّرِيۡنَ وَمُنۡذِرِيۡنَ‌ۚ وَيُجَادِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِالۡبَاطِلِ لِيُدۡحِضُوۡا بِهِ الۡحَـقَّ‌ وَاتَّخَذُوۡۤا اٰيٰتِىۡ وَمَاۤ اُنۡذِرُوۡا هُزُوًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We do not send Messengers but as Bearers of glad tidings (to the people) and as Warners. And the disbelievers dispute with (these Messengers) taking leverage of false arguments so as to eliminate the Truth with (falsehood). And they scoff at My Revelations and the (torment) of which they are warned.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَنۡ اَظۡلَمُ مِمَّنۡ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ فَاَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَا وَنَسِىَ مَا قَدَّمَتۡ يَدٰهُ‌ؕ اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا عَلٰى قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ اَكِنَّةً اَنۡ يَّفۡقَهُوۡهُ وَفِىۡۤ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرًا‌ؕ وَّاِنۡ تَدۡعُهُمۡ اِلَى الۡهُدٰى فَلَنۡ يَّهۡتَدُوۡۤا اِذًا اَبَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And who is a greater wrongdoer than one who was reminded of the Signs of Allah but he turned away from them and forgot those (evil deeds) which his hands had sent forward? Verily We have cast veils over their hearts so that they may (not) understand this Truth and have plugged their ears with heaviness (so that they may not hear this Truth). And if you invite them towards guidance, never ever will they take guidance.

Verses.VerseAr: وَرَبُّكَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ ذُوۡ الرَّحۡمَةِ‌ؕ لَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُهُمۡ بِمَا كَسَبُوۡا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ‌ؕ بَل لَّهُمۡ مَّوۡعِدٌ لَّنۡ يَّجِدُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مَوۡٮِٕلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And your Lord is Most Forgiving, Full of Mercy. If He had to take them to task for their doings, He would certainly have sent the torment upon them quickly. And in truth the Hour of Promise is (appointed) for them. (When that time comes) they will not find any place of shelter except with Him.

Verses.VerseAr: وَتِلۡكَ الۡقُرٰٓى اَهۡلَكۡنٰهُمۡ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوۡا وَجَعَلۡنَا لِمَهۡلِكِهِمۡ مَّوۡعِدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And these are the towns whose inhabitants We destroyed when they perpetrated oppression and injustice. And We had fixed a time for their destruction.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذۡ قَالَ مُوۡسٰى لِفَتٰٮهُ لَاۤ اَبۡرَحُ حَتّٰۤى اَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ الۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ اَوۡ اَمۡضِىَ حُقُبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (And also call to mind the incident) when Musa (Moses) said to his (young companion and) servant (Yusha‘ ibn Nun [Joshua] the son of Nun): ‘I will not step (back) until I arrive at the junction of the two seas or I travel on infinitely.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَيۡنِهِمَا نَسِيَا حُوۡتَهُمَا فَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِىۡ الۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So when both of them reached the junction of the two seas, they forgot their fish (there). So, that (fried fish came back to life and) made its way into the sea like a tunnel (and slipped off).

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتٰٮهُ اٰتِنَا غَدَآءَنَا لَقَدۡ لَقِيۡنَا مِنۡ سَفَرِنَا هٰذَا نَصَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, when both of them had gone ahead, Musa (Moses) asked his servant: ‘Bring us our meal. Surely we have faced great hardship during our this journey.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَرَءَيۡتَ اِذۡ اَوَيۡنَاۤ اِلَى الصَّخۡرَةِ فَاِنِّىۡ نَسِيۡتُ الۡحُوۡتَ  وَمَاۤ اَنۡسٰٮنِيۡهُ اِلَّا الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَنۡ اَذۡكُرَهٗ‌‌ۚ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبِيۡلَهٗ فِىۡ الۡبَحۡر‌ِ‌ۖ عَجَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (The servant) said: ‘Did you see when we reposed beside the rock? I forgot the fish (there) and none but Satan made me forget to mention it to you. And that fish (after coming back to life) made its way into the sea in a strange way (and it disappeared).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِ‌‌ۖ فَارۡتَدَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said: ‘That is the place we were looking for.’ So both returned to (the same place), tracing the (same track) following their footsteps.

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَجَدَا عَبۡدًا مِّنۡ عِبَادِنَاۤ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا وَعَلَّمۡنٰهُ مِنۡ لَّدُنَّا عِلۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then both found (there) one of Our (elite) servants (Khidr) upon whom We had bestowed from Our Presence (special) mercy and had taught him Our infused knowledge (i.e. the inspired knowledge of secrets and Gnostics).

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَهٗ مُوۡسٰى هَلۡ اَتَّبِعُكَ عَلٰٓى اَنۡ تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمَّا عُلِّمۡتَ رُشۡدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said to him: ‘Can I stay with you under this (condition) that you will teach me (as well) some of that knowledge which has been conferred on you for guidance.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِىَ صَبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: He (Khidr) said: ‘No doubt, you will not be able to have patience being in my company.

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَيۡفَ تَصۡبِرُ عَلٰى مَا لَمۡ تُحِطۡ بِهٖ خُبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how can you observe patience in (the matter of) which you will not have acquired (thorough) knowledge?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِىۡۤ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ صَابِرًا وَّلَاۤ اَعۡصِىۡ لَكَ اَمۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said: ‘You will certainly find me patient, if Allah so pleases, and I will not violate any of your instructions.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ فَاِنِ اتَّبَعۡتَنِىۡ فَلَا تَسۡـَٔـلۡنِىۡ عَنۡ شَىۡءٍ حَتّٰٓى اُحۡدِثَ لَـكَ مِنۡهُ ذِكۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Khidr) said: ‘So if you are in my company then do not question me about any thing until I myself mention that to you.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَانطَلَقَا حَتّٰۤى اِذَا رَكِبَا فِىۡ السَّفِيۡنَةِ خَرَقَهَا‌ؕ قَالَ اَخَرَقۡتَهَا لِتُغۡرِقَ اَهۡلَهَا‌ۚ لَقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيْئًا اِمۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So both of them set out till, when they embarked on a boat, (Khidr) bored a hole in it. Musa (Moses) said: ‘Have you bored (a hole in) it to drown the people aboard? Surely you have done something strange.’

Words.MeaningEn: he made a hole in it
Have you made a hole in it

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِىَ صَبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Khidr) said: ‘Did I not tell you that you would not be able to restrain yourself in my company?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذۡنِىۡ بِمَا نَسِيۡتُ وَلَا تُرۡهِقۡنِىۡ مِنۡ اَمۡرِىۡ عُسۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said: ‘Call me not to account for my omission and put me not in any more difficulty in (this) affair of mine.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَانْطَلَقَا حَتّٰۤى اِذَا لَقِيَا غُلٰمًا فَقَتَلَهٗۙ قَالَ اَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيۡرِ نَفۡسٍ ؕلَّـقَدۡ جِئۡتَ شَيْئًا نُّكۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then both of them proceeded till they met a boy. (Khidr) killed him. Musa (Moses) said: ‘Have you killed an innocent soul without any (retribution due) for anyone killed? Indeed you have done a horrible thing.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُل لَّكَ اِنَّكَ لَنۡ تَسۡتَطِيۡعَ مَعِىَ صَبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Khidr) said: ‘Did I not tell you that you would never be able to keep patience in my company?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اِنۡ سَاَلۡـتُكَ عَنۡ شَىۡءٍۢ بَعۡدَهَا فَلَا تُصٰحِبۡنِىۡ‌ۚ قَدۡ بَلَـغۡتَ مِنۡ لَّدُنِّىۡ عُذۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Musa (Moses) said: ‘If I ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me with you. Indeed, in my opinion, you have reached the limit to excuse.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَانطَلَقَا حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَتَيَاۤ اَهۡلَ قَرۡيَةِ ۨاسۡتَطۡعَمَاۤ اَهۡلَهَا فَاَبَوۡا اَنۡ يُّضَيِّفُوۡهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيۡهَا جِدَارًا يُّرِيۡدُ اَنۡ يَّـنۡقَضَّ فَاَقَامَهٗ‌ؕ قَالَ لَوۡ شِئۡتَ لَـتَّخَذۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ اَجۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then both set off, until they reached the people of a town; both asked its residents for food but they refused to entertain them. Then they found there a wall which was about to fall. (Khidr) erected it. Musa (Moses) said: ‘If you desired, you could take wages for this (construction work).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ هٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنِكَ‌‌ۚ سَاُنَـبِّئُكَ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡتَطِع عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Khidr) said: ‘This is the parting (time) between me and you. Now I impart to you the truth of the matters about which you have not been able to keep patience.

Verses.VerseAr: اَمَّا السَّفِيۡنَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسٰكِيۡنَ يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡبَحۡرِ فَاَرَدتُّ اَنۡ اَعِيۡبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ مَّلِكٌ يَّاۡخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِيۡنَةٍ غَصۡبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: As for the boat, that belonged to some poor people who used to toil for wages on the river. So I decided to make it defective (because) a (cruel) king was (standing) ahead of them, snatching every (undamaged) boat by force (from the owners without any compensation).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الۡغُلٰمُ فَكَانَ اَبَوٰهُ مُؤۡمِنَيۡنِ فَخَشِيۡنَاۤ اَنۡ يُّرۡهِقَهُمَا طُغۡيَانًا وَّكُفۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And as for the boy, his parents were blessed with faith. So we feared that (if he lived on he would become a disbeliever, and on attaining to maturity) he would afflict both of them with disobedience and disbelief.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَرَدۡنَاۤ اَنۡ يُّبۡدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهُ زَكٰوةً وَّاَقۡرَبَ رُحۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So we intended that their Lord might bless them with (such) a substitute as would be better than this (boy) in purity and nearer (to his parents as well) in clemency and kindness.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا الۡجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلٰمَيۡنِ يَتِيۡمَيۡنِ فِىۡ الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ وَكَانَ تَحۡتَهٗ كَنۡزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ اَبُوۡهُمَا صَالِحًـاۚ فَاَرَادَ رَبُّكَ اَنۡ يَّبۡلُغَاۤ اَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسۡتَخۡرِجَا كَنۡزَهُمَاۖ رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ‌‌ۚ وَمَا فَعَلۡتُهٗ عَنۡ اَمۡرِىۡ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَاۡوِيۡلُ مَا لَمۡ تَسۡطِعْ عَّلَيۡهِ صَبۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And as for the wall, that belonged to two orphan boys (residing) in the town. And a treasure was (buried) beneath it for both of them. And their father was (a) pious (man). So your Lord willed that both of them should reach their age of maturity and dig out their treasure (themselves) by Mercy from your Lord. And I did not do (whatever I did) of my own accord. This is the truth (of the matters) about which you could not hold yourself.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَسۡــَٔلُوۡنَكَ عَنۡ ذِىۡ الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ‌ؕ قُلۡ سَاَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ ذِكۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And, (O Most Esteemed Beloved,) they ask you about Dhu’l-Qarnain. Say: ‘I recite to you an account of him now.’

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهٗ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ مِنۡ كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ سَبَبًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (In ancient times) We did grant him power in the land and blessed (his regime) with all the means and resources.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاَ تۡبَعَ سَبَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then he went after (more) resources,

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا بَلَغَ مَغۡرِبَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغۡرُبُ فِىۡ عَيۡنٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَّوَجَدَ عِنۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا‌  ؕ قُلۡنَا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِمَّاۤ اَنۡ تُعَذِّبَ وَاِمَّاۤ اَنۡ تَتَّخِذَ فِيۡهِمۡ حُسۡنًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until he reached the boundary of (a locality towards) the West where he perceived the setting of the sun as if going down into a spring of (muddy black) hot water, and he found a people (living) there. We said: ‘O Dhu’l-Qarnain, (it is up to you) whether you punish them or treat them nicely.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ اَمَّا مَنۡ ظَلَمَ فَسَوۡفَ نُعَذِّبُهٗ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ فَيُعَذِّبُهٗ عَذَابًا نُّكۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Dhu’l-Qarnain said: ‘Whoever perpetrates injustice (by way of disbelief and mischief-mongering) we will certainly punish him. He will then be brought back to his Lord. And then He will award him most grievous punishment.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاَمَّا مَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَلَهٗ جَزَآءَ ۨالۡحُسۡنٰى‌ۚ وَسَنَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ مِنۡ اَمۡرِنَا يُسۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And whoever believes and does pious acts will have better reward, and We shall (also) say for him in Our Commands what is lenient.’

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then (after consolidating his conquests in the West) he set forth on (another) course,

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا بَلَغَ مَطۡلِعَ الشَّمۡسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطۡلُعُ عَلٰى قَوۡمٍ لَّمۡ نَجۡعَلْ لَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِهَا سِتۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until he reached the boundary (of a locality in the direction) of the sunrise. There he perceived (the rising of) the sun (as if) it were rising on the people (living in that piece of land) for whom We had provided no cover (for protection) against the sun (i.e. they lived in the caves, without clothes and houses).

Verses.VerseAr: كَذٰلِكَؕ وَقَدۡ اَحَطۡنَا بِمَا لَدَيۡهِ خُبۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: It occurred the same way. And We have encompassed with Our knowledge whatever he had.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اَتۡبَعَ سَبَبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Having accomplished his conquests in the East,) he then followed (still another) route,

Verses.VerseAr: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا بَلَغَ بَيۡنَ السَّدَّيۡنِ وَجَدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمَا قَوۡمًاۙ لَّا يَكَادُوۡنَ يَفۡقَهُوۡنَ قَوۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Until he reached (a place) between two mountains. He found a people dwelling behind these mountains. They were unable to understand (anyone’s) speech.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالُوۡا يٰذَا الۡقَرۡنَيۡنِ اِنَّ يَاۡجُوۡجَ وَمَاۡجُوۡجَ مُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِىۡ الۡاَرۡضِ فَهَلۡ نَجۡعَلُ لَكَ خَرۡجًا عَلٰٓى اَنۡ تَجۡعَلَ بَيۡنَـنَا وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ سَدًّا‏
Verses.VerseEn: They said: ‘O Dhu’l-Qarnain! Gog and Magog have spread disorder in the land. Should we fix some money (as a tribute) for you on this (condition) that you raise a high wall between us and them?’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّىۡ فِيۡهِ رَبِّىۡ خَيۡرٌ فَاَعِيۡنُوۡنِىۡ بِقُوَّةٍ اَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Dhu’l-Qarnain) said: ‘The power my Lord has given me in this connection is better. Assist me with your vigour (diligence and labour) and I shall erect a fortified wall between you and them.

Verses.VerseAr: اٰتُوۡنِىۡ زُبَرَ الۡحَدِيۡدِ‌ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا سَاوٰى بَيۡنَ الصَّدَفَيۡنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوۡا‌ؕ حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَعَلَهٗ نَارًاۙ قَالَ اٰتُوۡنِىۡۤ اُفۡرِغۡ عَلَيۡهِ قِطۡرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Bring me large blocks of iron.’ So, when he levelled (that iron wall) between the two (mountain) tops, he said: ‘(Now) blow (it after putting it on fire).’ So, when he turned that (iron) into a fire (by successive blowing) he said: ‘(Now) bring me molten copper to pour on it.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَمَا اسۡطَاعُوۡۤا اَنۡ يَّظۡهَرُوۡهُ وَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا لَهٗ نَـقۡبًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then, they (Gog and Magog) did not have the ability to scale it, nor could they acquire the capability to bore through it.

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ هٰذَا رَحۡمَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّىۡ‌ۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّىۡ جَعَلَهٗ دَكَّآءَ‌ۚ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّىۡ حَقًّاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Dhu’l-Qarnain) said: ‘This is Mercy from my Lord. But when my Lord’s promise (of the Last Hour) comes (near), He will (demolish this wall and) level it with the ground (i.e. it will be reduced to dust particles). And the promise of my Lord is bound to come true.’

Verses.VerseAr: وَتَرَكۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ يَّمُوۡجُ فِىۡ بَعۡضٍ‌ وَّنُفِخَ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ فَجَمَعۡنٰهُمۡ جَمۡعًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And at that time We shall release (all the creation or Gog and Magog). They will run into each other (like surging waves). And the trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them all (in the Last Day Assembly).

Verses.VerseAr: وَّعَرَضۡنَا جَهَـنَّمَ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ لِّـلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ عَرۡضَاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: On that Day, We shall present Hell before the disbelievers fully exposed,

Verses.VerseAr: ۨالَّذِيۡنَ كَانَتۡ اَعۡيُنُهُمۡ فِىۡ غِطَآءٍ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِىۡ وَكَانُوۡا لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ سَمۡعًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Those whose eyes were veiled (by negligence) against My remembrance and they could not even listen (to My remembrance).

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اَنۡ يَّتَّخِذُوۡا عِبَادِىۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِىۡۤ اَوۡلِيَآءَ‌ؕ اِنَّاۤ اَعۡتَدۡنَا جَهَـنَّمَ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ نُزُلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Do the disbelievers think that, instead of Me, they will take My servants as helpers? Surely, We have prepared Hell as hospitality for the disbelievers.

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ هَلۡ نُـنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِالۡاَخۡسَرِيۡنَ اَعۡمَالاًؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘Shall We alert you of those who are great losers in respect of deeds?

Verses.VerseAr: الَّذِيۡنَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِىۡ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُوۡنَ صُنۡعًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is those whose entire struggle is wasted in worldly life, but they presume they are doing very good works.’

Verses.VerseAr: اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَلِقَآٮِٕهٖ فَحَبِطَتۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ فَلَا نُقِيۡمُ لَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَزۡنًـا‏
Verses.VerseEn: It is they who have denied the Signs of their Lord and meeting Him (after death). So all their deeds are ruined, and We shall not give any weight or (even) any worth to them on the Day of Rising.

Verses.VerseAr: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوۡا وَاتَّخَذُوۡۤا اٰيٰتِىۡ وَرُسُلِىۡ هُزُوًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: This very Hell is their reward because they kept disbelieving and mocking My Signs and My Messengers.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَانَتۡ لَهُمۡ جَنّٰتُ الۡفِرۡدَوۡسِ نُزُلاًۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely those who believe and do good deeds persistently shall have the Gardens of Paradise as their hospitality.

Verses.VerseAr: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا لَا يَـبۡغُوۡنَ عَنۡهَا حِوَلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will always live there. They will never seek any change (of abode) from there.

Verses.VerseAr: قُل لَّوۡ كَانَ الۡبَحۡرُ مِدَادًا لِّـكَلِمٰتِ رَبِّىۡ لَـنَفِدَ الۡبَحۡرُ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ تَـنۡفَدَ كَلِمٰتُ رَبِّىۡ وَلَوۡ جِئۡنَا بِمِثۡلِهٖ مَدَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘If the ocean turns into ink for the Words of my Lord, that ocean will exhaust before the Words of my Lord come to an end, even if We bring another similar (ocean or ink) to refill.’

Verses.VerseAr: قُلۡ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوۡحٰٓى اِلَىَّ اَنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰـهٌ وَّاحِدٌ‌ ۚ فَمَنۡ كَانَ يَرۡجُوۡا لِقَآءَ رَبِّهٖ فَلۡيَـعۡمَلۡ عَمَلاً صَالِحًـا وَلَا يُشۡرِكۡ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهٖۤ اَحَدًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Say: ‘I look like you only (by virtue of my visible creation) as a man. (Otherwise just think what congruity you have with me.) It is I to whom the Revelation is transmitted that your God is the One and only God. (And just see to it whether you have any such divine potential that the Word of Allah may come down to you.) So, whoever hopes to meet his Lord should do good deeds and must not associate any partner in the worship of his Lord.’
